# Version 4.156.3 (Unreleased)
> **Rendering and allocation reliability**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.3 updates Skia m156 with safer GPU allocations and corrected image filtering and glyph rendering. The native servicing update leaves managed APIs and the native C ABI unchanged.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **GPU filtering and draw bounds** — Prevents Ganesh image filters from sampling unwritten scratch-texture texels through mipmaps and clips destination reads to their intended bounds. Graphite also resets depth tracking after overwriting draws to preserve painter order. ([#5837](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5837))
- **FreeType LCD glyph cropping** — Corrects LCD16 bitmap bounds and cropping when successive glyph loads return different outlines, avoiding misaligned copies and assertions. Outline translation is also checked for overflow. ([#5837](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5837))
- **Checked GPU buffer allocation** — Rejects overflowing or invalid Ganesh buffer sizes and skips draws when allocation fails instead of proceeding with an invalid buffer. ([#5837](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5837))
